kurals.tr: Alarezha Aaruyir Na�rkum Adhanaip / Palarariyaar Paakkiyath Thaal
kurals.m: My precious life is saved by the raise of rumour, and this, to my good luck no others are aware of

kurals.tr: Malaranna Kannaal Arumai Ariyaadhu / Alaremakku Eendhadhiv Voor
kurals.m: Not knowing the value of her whose eyes are like flowers this town has got up a rumour about me

kurals.tr: Uraaadho Oorarindha Kelavai Adhanaip / Peraaadhu Petranna Neerththu
kurals.m: Will I not get a rumour that is known to the (whole) town ? For what I have not got is as if I had got it (already)

kurals.tr: Kavvaiyaal Kavvidhu Kaamam Adhuvindrel / Thavvennum Thanmai Izhandhu
kurals.m: Rumour increases the violence of my passion; without it it would grow weak and waste away

kurals.tr: Kaliththorum Kalluntal Vettatraal Kaamam / Velippatun Thorum Inidhu
kurals.m: As drinking liquor is delightful (to one) whenever one is in mirth, so is lust delightful to me whenever it is the subject of rumour

kurals.tr: Kantadhu Mannum Orunaal Alarmannum / Thingalaip Paampukon Tatru
kurals.m: It was but a single day that I looked on (my lover); but the rumour thereof has spread like the seizure of the moon by the serpent

kurals.tr: Ooravar Kelavai Eruvaaka Annaisol / Neeraaka Neelumin Noi
kurals.m: This malady (of lust) is manured by the talk of women and watered by the (harsh) words of my mother

kurals.tr: Neyyaal Erinudhuppem Endratraal Kelavaiyaal / Kaamam Nudhuppem Enal
kurals.m: To say that one could extinguish passion by rumour is like extinguishing fire with ghee

kurals.tr: Alarnaana Olvadho Anjalompu Endraar / Palarnaana Neeththak Katai
kurals.m: When the departure of him who said "fear not" has put me to shame before others, why need I be ashamed of scandal

kurals.tr: Thaamventin Nalkuvar Kaadhalar Yaamventum / Kelavai Etukkumiv Voor
kurals.m: The rumour I desire is raised by the town (itself); and my lover would if desired consent (to my following him)
